list.title: Schedules
list.subTitle: Schedules determine when specific workflows are executed, either on a defined timetable or based on triggers. Status legend: <blueDot/> running, <greenDot/> last run succeeded, <redDot/> last run failed, <grayDot/> no cron and no run history. The number under the circle is a countdown to the next cron trigger.
